0022600137.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-3, on a two-game losing streak and 4th in the Central, 2.5 games back) host the New York Knicks (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 13th in the East), with the Bulls at 0-1 at home so far. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Patrick Williams is day-to-day with groin soreness and is a game-time decision, while Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain. There have been no games between the two teams in 2026-27, but the Bulls lost 1-3 to the Knicks in 2025-26, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
